"''In our position, you take what you can get, kid.|Ezra Bridger and Kanan Jarrus|}} The '''''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvette''', also known as the '''''Sphyrna''-class C80 corvette''' and known more commonly as the '''Hammerhead corvette''', was a model of [[corvette]] that saw wide use during the [[Imperial Era]] as an armed [[transport]], and later served as a mainline [[warship]] in the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|naval forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and subsequent [[New Republic Security Bureau]] during and after the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. The corvette witnessed continued use during the [[Cold War]] by the [[Resistance]] against the [[First Order]], and subsequently in the [[First Order-Resistance War|pan-galactic war]] between [[Citizens' Fleet|the forces]] of [[the galaxy]] and the [[Sith Eternal]]. ==Characteristics== ===General characteristics=== [[File:HammerheadCorvette-SaS.png|thumb|left|190px|A rebel Hammerhead corvette accompanied by two [[CR90 corvette]]s.]] ''Sphyrna''-class "Hammerhead" [[corvette]]s, or ''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvettes{{HelmetCollectionCite|71|Helmets}} and also referred to as C80 corvettes or simply as ''Hammerhead''-class [[cruiser]]s, were inspired by a [[Unidentified starship class|similar]] [[starship]] design by [[Rendili Hyperworks]] that dated back [[Standard century|centuries]] prior to the [[Imperial Era]].{{Databank|hammerhead-corvette|Hammerhead Corvette}} The ''Sphyrna''-class was a joint operation between two companies, as it was designed by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]] and manufactured by [[Rendili StarDrive]]. A big, bulky [[transport]], the Hammerhead was built for the transportation of goods and individuals safely, comfortably, and without the need for escort ships. It had a cylinder-shaped [[hull]] that contained a number of large modular cargo holds, external docking points for cargo containers, and an external cargo lift. The flight deck, crew berths, and passenger staterooms were located in the angular, vertical bow, which gave the ship its notable physical profile and name. Three large pylon mounted [[Ion engine|ion sublight engines]] dominated the ship's aft which gave it a sublight speed of 900 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]]. The [[engine]]s were placed on an inverted triangular engine block which also housed the ship's main [[reactor]], the ship's [[hyperdrive]], and the bulk of the [[engineer]]ing section.{{BuildFalconCite|86|Starship Fact File}} The Hammerhead was equipped with a primary class 3 [[hyperdrive]] along with a secondary class 15. It was equipped with a [[navigation computer]] and a medium range [[sensor]]. [[File:HammerheadCorvetteAft-MMSWSB.png|thumb|left|250px|Aft view showing the engine block]] The engine block was connected to the ship's main fuselage, ultimately ending up at the front of the ship at its spacious [[cockpit]]. The [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the Hammerhead had four crew stations, though it could be operated by two crew members, or in certain situations even a single [[pilot]]. Despite this, it could be fully crewed by thirty-five crew members and carry 125 passengers. A circular tactical display console was used for crew briefings, often led by the [[Battle group|fleet group]] [[commander]] to coordinate their ships. The console was situated in the middle of the bridge room, behind the command chair. It held enough consumables for six [[Standard month|months]] and cost 1,000,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to manufacture. Hammerheads typically held a cargo capacity of 22,833 [[metric ton]]s. ===Armament and defense=== Hammerhead corvettes carried a respectable armament of heavy [[laser cannon]]s and [[turbolaser]]s, with the standard variant being armed with two dual forward-mounted heavy [[laser]] [[cannon]]s by the bridge and a dorsal [[turret]]-mounted twin light [[turbolaser]] battery at the ship's engine block. The ship's internal systems were easy to maintain and upgrade, and were backed by numerous redundant systems; because of this, popular upgrades were to add a second turbolaser battery and to upgrade the ship's ion engines for even greater speed. [[File:External-racks.png|thumb|left|200px|Additional external weapons racks on a Hammerhead corvette.]] The hammerhead was specifically designed for ramming attacks; a common tactic was to keep the hammerhead facing an opponent, to keep its powerful forward shields and tough reinforced hull in line for a potential ram - even heavy collisions only resulted in minor damage to a hammerhead's bow. In addition to standard armament, Hammerheads could mount external ordnance racks,{{Armada|set=Hammerhead Corvettes Expansion Pack|cardname=External Racks}} as well as [[Quad turbolaser cannon|quad turbolaser batteries]].{{Armada|set=Imperial Light Carrier Expansion Pack|cardname=Quad Battery Turrets}} With its heavy defenses and ramming ability coupled with a decent armament, Hammerheads were deployed as heavy attack ships, and were fully capable of taking on vessels of similar size, or even larger ships when deployed in groups. ===Variants and upgrades=== Throughout its existence, several variants of the Hammerhead existed. One was commonly seen utilized by early rebel cells that featured a large ventral cargo bay and three dual [[laser cannon]], as well as a vertically-elongated bridge section characteristic of the Hammerhead. In its early years, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] continued to use this model.{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}} The [[Hammerhead Scout Corvette]] and the [[Hammerhead Torpedo Corvette]] were part of this variant. [[File:HammerheadTorpedoCorvette-SWA.png|thumb|right|240px|A trio of Hammerhead Torpedo Corvettes.]] By [[1 BBY]], however, the Alliance had modified its previous Hammerheads, such as the ''[[Lightmaker]]'', into a slightly different refit. Several new features were added to the original Hammerhead structure, including two extra modules mounted to the port and starboard of the craft at the [[docking tube]]s, which included a ventral and a dorsal turret-mounted twin light turbolaser battery, increasing the total number from one to five. Six [[escape pod]]s were added in place of the cargo bay, and a fourth sublight ion drive mounted on top of the primary three, giving it enough power to single-handedly move a disabled [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]]. Additionally, the hull and frame of the ship was fitted with additional modules and compartments. Due to the ship's easily upgradeable systems and tough hulls, [[smuggler]]s and [[pirate]]s acquired Hammerheads and highly modified them with more powerful armament and better cargo-handling systems. ==Role== [[File:FantasyFlight_Garels_Honor.png|thumb|left|200px|The rebel Hammerhead ''Garel's Honor'' rams an Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruiser]] In a civilian capacity, Hammerhead corvettes were utilized by shipping companies for the transportation of goods and personnel. Smugglers and pirates utilized Hammerhead corvettes as part of their fleets. In military capacities, the Alliance deployed Hammerheads with great effectiveness against the [[Imperial Navy]]. The Alliance used Hammerheads as a heavy attack craft, pitting itself against vessels of the same size or larger while in groups. Pointing itself towards a target, a Hammerhead kept its strongest shields between it and its opponent and remain aligned for a potential ram, and were specially used for ramming. Additional military roles included serving as an escort, a [[scout ship]], and as a [[spacetug]]. ==History== ===Early service=== The ''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvette predated the [[CR-series]] [[corvette]]s from the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]], including the [[CR70 corvette]] that was active during the implementation of [[Order 66]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars]]. ===Imperial Era=== {{Quote|Senator Organa heard about our losses on Garel. He's sending us reinforcements. His agent is coming to Lothal with three cruisers.''"
"''Three cruisers? That is good news.|Captain Hera Syndulla and Jedi Kanan Jarrus|}} [[File:HammerheadCorvette-Fathead.png|thumb|right|250px|A profile view of Hanmmerhead corvette]] Already [[Standard decade|decades]] old during the [[Imperial Era]], Hammerhead corvettes were used by private shipping companies, smuggler and pirate fleets, and by other factions, including the [[House of Organa|Royal House of Alderaan]]. Shortly after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]{{TBB|Battle Scars}} in [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Battle Scars]]" to [[19 BBY]]. at least one derelict Hammerhead corvette was among the wreckage on the [[planet]] [[Bracca]] alongside other [[starship]]s including [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnoughts]], and [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]]. By [[3 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[A Princess on Lothal]]" to [[3 BBY]]. after learning of the losses of the early Alliance's [[Phoenix Cell]] at the [[Battle of Garel]], Imperial [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan]] dispatched his adopted daughter, [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], along with three Hammerhead corvettes—''Lightmaker'', ''Amity's Arrow'', and ''Duchess Senna''—from the [[Royal Alderaan Civil Fleet]] to [[Lothal]] to reinforce the rebel group, under the guise of a [[Imperial Senate|Senate]]-sponsored delivery of relief supplies to the people of Lothal. [[Phoenix Leader]] [[Captain]] [[Hera Syndulla]] informed [[Jedi]] [[Kanan Jarrus]] about the situation, and he and his [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]] traveled to [[Jalath]] [[city]] to receive them. The princess planned for the [[Spectres]] to steal them to conceal Alderaan's involvement with the rebellion, but Imperial [[Lieutenant]] [[Yogar Lyste]], the port commander, installed [[gravity lock]]s and deployed two [[All Terrain Armored Transport (Prototype)|AT-ATs]] to prevent the corvettes from being stolen. With the aid of former [[Governor of the Lothal sector|Governor of Lothal]] [[Ryder Azadi]], who had constructed the locks while he was in [[prison]], the rebels were able to [[Mission on Lothal|commandeer]] the corvettes and add them to their growing fleet within [[Standard hour|hours]] of their arrival. [[File:Alderaanian-fleet.png|thumb|left|250px|Three ships of the Alderaanian fleet are deployed to Lothal to join the Phoenix Cell rebel group.]] After the mission, Leia Organa sent a correspondence to the Imperial [[Governor]] of the [[Lothal sector]], [[Moff]] [[Stattata]], 650,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] per vessel stolen—along with an extra 292,500 credits for the 68,500 metric tons of cargo that consisted of relief supplies the vessels were fully-loaded with—as "full Imperial compensation" with threats of bringing the matter to the attention of the Senate. Sometime later in [[2 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[The Holocrons of Fate]]" to [[2 BBY]]. the former [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]] assaulted one of Phoenix Cell's corvettes. He interrogated the crew, leading to Maul [[Maul's capture of the Ghost crew|capturing]] the ''[[Ghost]]'' personnel in order to unlock [[holocron]]s.{{Rebels|The Holocrons of Fate}} While Phoenix Cell was headquartered on [[Chopper Base]] on the [[planet]] [[Atollon]], Phoenix Cell ships were stationed at the base. [[CR90 corvette]]s, [[GR-75 medium transport]]s, and Hammerhead corvettes usually docked at the base for repair or resupply as Chopper Base became an important hub for the Alliance in the [[Outer Rim Territories]].{{HelmetCollectionCite|57|Weapons & Uniforms}} Later, [[Phoenix Cell]] escorted one of their Hammerheads to [[Skirmish over Mykapo|evacuate]] rebel sympathizers at [[Mykapo]] in front of an imminent Imperial takeover.{{Rebels|Iron Squadron (episode)}} The same transport, was later destroyed during the [[Battle of Atollon]].{{Rebels|Zero Hour}} ===Galactic Civil War=== {{Quote|Call up a Hammerhead corvette. I have an idea.|Admiral Raddus during the Battle of Scarif|}} [[File:Lightmaker.jpg|thumb|right|260px|The ''Lightmaker'' intentionally collides with the ''Persecutor'' during the Battle of Scarif.]] After the rebellion was reorganized into the Alliance to Restore the Republic, several modified Hammerheads partially made up the motley assortment of vessels that was the nascent [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]]. One such ship was the ''Lightmaker'', which was part of [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]]' fleet just prior to the [[Battle of Yavin]], under the command of [[Kado Oquoné]]. The vessel was present at the Battle of Scarif. During the battle, Raddus ordered it to ram into the side of the disabled ''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer ''[[Persecutor]]'', causing it to crash into a second [[Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Intimidator]]'', and then into the [[Shield Gate]], allowing the [[Death Star plans]] to be transmitted from the Imperial base on the [[planet]]'s surface. After the transmission is received by the fleet, at least one Hammerhead corvette, the ''[[Consonance]]'', along with some of the fleet began the jump into [[hyperspace]] just seconds before the arrival of the ''[[Devastator]]''. Shortly after the [[siege on Tureen VII]], at least one Hammerhead corvette was present with a large contingent of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]],[[Star Wars (2015) 26|''Star Wars'' (2015) 26]] while another painted in [[Color|orange]] markings was active in a small Alliance naval group along with an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]], a [[CR90 corvette]], and several [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]]s.[[Star Wars (2015) 35|''Star Wars'' (2015) 35]] At one [[time]], a shipping company owner in financial trouble planned to use their Hammerhead corvette to ram the [[Imperial Central Bank]]'s [[aurodium]] vault for the [[Halla sector]]. In another instance, an eccentric [[engineer]] sought to test the limits of the Hammerhead's ramming capability by designing a ship-sized [[vibroblade]] to be fitted to the front of a Hammerhead corvette, although there were unforeseen consequences of the innovative modification. ===New Republic Era=== One Hammerhead corvette, the ''[[Sterdic Star]]'', was part of the [[Resistance navy|naval force]] of the [[Resistance]]. The ''Sterdic Star'' was damaged during a [[Mission to Taul|mission]] and crashed on [[Taul]], killing the ship's crew except for [[C-3PO]] and a group of [[droid]]s. In [[35 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]]. numerous Hammerhead corvettes were part of an [[Citizens' Fleet|enormous fleet]] of 14,000 vessels{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-escape-part-2-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 5 Fun Facts from "The Escape - Part 2" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} rallied by [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca]] in the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' as they flew across the [[Core Worlds]] to assist the Resistance destroy the [[Final Order]], a massive armada of the [[Sith Eternal]], stationed in [[Exegol]]'s [[atmosphere]] during the [[Battle of Exegol]]. [[File:Galaxy_fleet_arrives_CA.png|thumb|left|250px|Hammerhead corvettes were part of the composition of the citizens' fleet of 14,000 ships.]] Initially alone, the Resistance forces succumbed to large casualties against the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] and were at the breaking point when the citizens' fleet arrived. The starships of the fleet began engaging the [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]] that had the potential to each single handedly destroy an entire [[planet]]. When the resurrected [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]] used a massive amount of [[Force lightning]], the ships of the citizens' fleet were disabled and began falling towards the planet's surface until Sidious began fighting the [[Jedi]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]]. The ships not destroyed then regained power and control, and continued to fight against the Sith armada. Eventually, Rey finally [[Death|killed]] Sidious and the remaining Sith forces were annihilated. Many Hammerheads then retreated from Exegol as the enormous galactic fleet left the planet. ==Behind the scenes== ''Sphynra''-class corvettes first appeared in "[[A Princess on Lothal]]," the tenth episode of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. The ships are based on the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruisers]] from the now [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/a-princess-on-lothal-trivia-gallery|text="A Princess on Lothal" Trivia Gallery}} In Linnaean taxonomy, ''Sphyrna'' is the genus name for the Earthly [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hammerhead_shark hammerhead sharks]. [[File:Thranta-class_corvette_TRF.jpg|thumb|right|the erroneous depiction from [[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]].]] In ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'', an image of the [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] from the ''Star Wars'' Legends video game, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' was used in place of a [[canon]] ''Sphyrna''-class corvette. Despite the specifications in ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' listing the ship as 315 meters, various episodes of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' and the film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' depict the vessel as considerably smaller (utilising other starships as relative reference), especially in its depictions alongside the ''Ghost'' and other vessels. [[Leland Chee]] later divulged on Twitter that the 315 meter-length assertion is incorrect and that dimensions derived from the production of ''Rogue One'' outlined the length as 116.7 meters (or 383 feet).{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/1181279349988712448|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=@EvanSchultheis Damn, you're right. The dimensions from Rogue One production list the length of the Hammerhead corvette as 116.7 m (383 feet) long.|archivedate=20191008022202}} The [[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|updated edition of the reference book]] rectifies this discrepancy by listing the rounded length of the aforementioned value (117 meters or 384 feet), within the data file box on the entry for the "Hammerhead Corvette". Since the second edition of ''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'' is a published and licensed reference work and not a clarification on social media, the articles defers to the latter work as a true canonical source. In the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] TTRPG sourcebook, ''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'', the book establishes that the ''Sphyrna''-class corvette is known as the ''Hammerhead''-class corvette. It also establishes that it was manufactured by [[Rendili StarDrive]], was worth 1,000,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], was equipped with three [[RSD 88D-II BrightStar ion engine]]s, had a class three primary hyperdrive and class fifteen backup hyperdrive, had a crew of 35 [[officer]]s and crew members, with a passenger capacity of 125. It also had six months worth of consumables. Additionally, it is stated that Rendili classified the vessels as "Armed Medium Transports." ''Dawn of Rebellion'' and ''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'' establishes that the ''Hammerhead''-class and ''Sphyrna''-class corvettes are intended to be the same starship, however, since the ''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'' is the most recent source and is not a roleplaying game sourcebook but a reference book, this article assumes that the encyclopedia contains factual information. ''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' erroneously refers to the ''Sphyrna''-class corvette as a ''Hammerhead''-class cruiser,''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' as
